headline: Punj Lloyd Limited: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process - Punj Lloyd Limited has informed the Exchange about Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process ; In terms of Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform that the Company has…
detail: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process - Punj Lloyd Limited has informed the Exchange about Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process ; In terms of Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform that the Company has received the resignation letter from Mr. Adhish Swaroop (ACS : 16034) from the position of Company Secretary & Compliance officer of the Company w.e.f 31.08.2026. Detailed Announcement along with the copy of Resignation letter is attached / submitted.
